# Skill-dev synthesis context (degraded)

The operator description signals work on an Agent Builder skill, but
the elastic-agent-builder-skill-dev CLI was not available at synthesis
time. Plan generation will still proceed; the skill-dev gate will run
again at task execution time and at PR-promotion time, where missing
CLI surfaces as a hard error.

To enable richer synthesis context (existing-skill similarity audit +
the up-to-date readiness checklist + per-category validation rules),
build the skill-dev MCP server:

    cd ~/Projects/elastic-agent-builder-skill-dev/packages/mcp-server
    npm install
    npm run build

Or set `SKILL_DEV_DIST_DIR` to the directory containing
`validate_skill.js` and `skill_context.js`.

Until then, treat your skill design as if it MUST satisfy:

- A descriptive name (>=3 chars), description (>=30 chars), and content body (>=100 chars).
- At least one real tool id from the Kibana catalog when toolIds is non-empty.
- Content that explicitly references its declared tool ids by name.
- Originality vs existing skills (no high overlap with anything already shipped).
- Schema + content within the OSS-model token budget.
